name: Çöl Kaktüsü
scene: A tall saguaro cactus in the desert under a big setting sun with dunes.
notes: Design sheet only. Cactus uses the green pair; sun, sky and dunes use amber and terracotta. Target 36–46 panes. Generated with clai image using vitray_lighthouse.png and vitray_poppies.png as style references and cactus-contacts.webp as subject reference; regenerated once after review to replace cactus grid crossings with transverse bands. Final image inspected: closed silhouette, opaque white exterior, recognisable cactus, no obvious dangling lines; remaining concerns are subtle fill shading, some same-colour background neighbours, close junctions around arm attachments and narrow dune tips. Raster connected-component estimate gives 62 coloured regions above 100 pixels, exceeding target before same-colour merging; this is not a validated traced pane count. Review and simplify during tracing. No geometry audit or game publication performed.
